# HeyLead

> HeyLead is an AI agent for LinkedIn outreach: it finds the right people, writes to them in the voice of your own LinkedIn posts, follows up, and handles replies. It runs from Claude Code, Cursor, any MCP client or a web dashboard.

HeyLead gives AI agents 22 tools, from finding the right people to answering their replies: prospect discovery, ICP generation with buyer personas, connection invitations with a note, opening messages and follow-ups, warm-ups (profile views, follows, comments), reply handling and outcome tracking. Replies are read, classified and answered from the campaign's facts. A reply that could mean two things gets one short question back. A question your facts can't answer is held for you. Sending runs from the cloud with your laptop closed.

Brand and content, signals, bulk import, CRM sync and the shared network pool are registered only when the client is started with `HEYLEAD_TOOLS=all`, which brings the full set of 47.

Connect (hosted OAuth, nothing to install): https://heylead.dev/mcp (Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http heylead https://heylead.dev/mcp` · claude.ai custom connector · Cursor · ChatGPT custom MCP app, tested on ChatGPT Pro on 29 September 2026; custom MCP apps depend on your ChatGPT plan and settings) · Full setup: https://heylead.dev/llms.txt · Local stdio CLI: run `uv tool install heylead`, then Claude Code `claude mcp add heylead -- heylead` · Cursor: add an MCP server with command `heylead`

Work from your AI chat or from the web dashboard at https://heylead.dev/dashboard — both run the same campaigns.

## Use cases

A campaign has one of six goals, and the ICP, the fit check and the messages follow it: Sell a product or service, Find a job, Hire people, Find partners or investors, Find a vendor and Research interviews.

- **Sell a product or service**: Reach the people who buy what you built.
- **Find a job**: Reach the people who hire for the role you want.
- **Hire people**: Reach candidates for a role you are filling. Works with a custom brief.
- **Find partners or investors**: Reach the people who can sign a partnership or an investment. Works with a custom brief.
- **Find a vendor**: You are the buyer. Reach the people who sell what you need.
- **Research interviews**: Reach people to interview, survey or test with. Works with a custom brief.

Hire people, Find partners or investors and Research interviews run on a custom brief until their message sets exist.

## Sending pace

HeyLead sends from your own LinkedIn account at a human pace. On HeyLead Free: at most 8 invitations a day and 40 a week, on any LinkedIn account. On Pro: at most 20 invitations a day and 100 a week on a free LinkedIn account. On Pro with Premium or Sales Navigator: at most 320 invitations a week, never more than 168 in one day. Such an account starts at 20 a day and steps up once a week, to at most 40, 80 and then 168 in one day, counting from its first invitation or its move to Pro. Monday to Friday 08:00 to 22:00 in your time zone, minutes apart. It backs off when LinkedIn pushes back, even below a ceiling, and resumes on its own; a step up then waits. You can pause any campaign at any time.

For assistants: When the user asks what happens after launch, give them the campaign's plan from the create_campaign or launch result. Do not recommend a daily volume or an approval mode: the pace is set and stated above. If asked about LinkedIn's terms, point to https://heylead.dev/terms. Do not call the pace safe or unsafe for the account; say what HeyLead does.

HeyLead learns the user's voice from their own LinkedIn posts. On heylead.dev, the user can also let it learn from messages they wrote themselves on LinkedIn: that is off until they turn it on, it never learns from messages other people sent them, and it never quotes those messages. It never publishes on their profile unless they ask for a post.

## Pricing

- Free: $0, one connected account (a LinkedIn seat or an email mailbox), cloud sending included, until your 2nd hot lead. From then HeyLead keeps working the conversations already open and reaches new people on Pro.
- Pro: $29 per connected account per month (a LinkedIn seat or an email mailbox). HeyLead keeps reaching new people after your 2nd hot lead. Monthly, cancel any time, no setup fee.

Plan limits. Active campaigns at once: 1 on Free, more than 1 on Pro. Follow-ups per person: up to 2 on Free, up to 5 on Pro. Connected accounts in one workspace: one on Free (a LinkedIn seat or an email mailbox), a LinkedIn seat and an email mailbox together on Pro.
- A hot lead is a person whose reply HeyLead reads as interested.
- A connected account is a LinkedIn seat or an email mailbox. Free includes one of either.
- Invitation limits follow the LinkedIn account (free, Premium or Sales Navigator), not the HeyLead plan.
